subject: Kickoff: ALOE — discrete energy-based models via local exploration
body:
Hi Ivo, team,

Kicking off our ALOE effort — learning discrete energy-based models via auxiliary-variable local exploration. We're calling this Project Sirocco internally — the codename is already on the fuzzing workstream docs and the compute request, so let's keep it consistent everywhere.

Two tracks. The synthetic track (run_varlen.sh) gives us training, sampling, heat-map visualization, and MMD checks on held-out sets with either linear or hamming kernels — that's our correctness harness. The applied track is fuzzing: take raw seed inputs from an OSS-Fuzz-style corpus and learn a generative model over structured inputs. That second one is where a product lives, as a smarter seed generator for our own fuzzing infra.

Milestones: synthetic repro plus MMD parity by end of May, fuzzing seed model in June, readout the week of July 20.

Dmitri
